question_text: Describe one difference between interrupt-driven input and polling in a control system.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: With interrupts, the device signals when it needs attention; with polling, the processor repeatedly checks device status even when no event has occurred.
